gloss: advance payment received; deposit taken in advance

definitions.explanation: Money collected from a customer before the goods are delivered or the service is performed. It counts as a liability until the work is done, because the business still owes something in return.

examples.japanese: {前受金|まえうけきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}った→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{着手前|ちゃくしゅまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{前受金|まえうけきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただいています→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: We receive an advance payment before construction begins.

examples.japanese: {前受金|まえうけきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}した→渡す：02442_watasu⟧⟦{時点|じてん}→時点：12970_jiten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}り→振り：03714_furi⟧⟦{替|か}える→替える：13399_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: The advance payment is transferred to sales at the point the goods are handed over.

examples.japanese: ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}り{消|け}された→取り消す：04224_torikesu⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、{前受金|まえうけきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全額|ぜんがく}→全額：16829_zengaku⟧⟦お{返|かえ}し→お返し：08354_okaeshi⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: If the order is cancelled, we will refund the advance payment in full.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧ (beforehand) + ⟦{受|う}け→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (receiving) + {金|きん} (money). Common in construction, custom manufacturing, and subscription businesses, where payment routinely comes before delivery.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {前受金|まえうけきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive an advance payment
- {前受金|まえうけきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返金|へんきん}する→返金する：21322_henkinsuru⟧: to refund an advance payment
- {前受金|まえうけきん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{計上|けいじょう}→計上：08006_keijou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to record as an advance received

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{前払金|まえばらいきん}→前払金：30222_maebaraikin⟧: advance paid — the mirror image, money the business pays out early
- ⟦{手付金|てつけきん}→手付金：29465_tetsukekin⟧: deposit — a smaller sum paid to secure a contract, often non-refundable
- ⟦{内金|うちきん}→内金：30223_uchikin⟧: part payment — a portion of the price paid up front
